candidates.statement: Never sum different currencies without an approved conversion and rate source.
`post(sourceType, sourceId, journalDraft, actor, idempotencyKey)` must run in one database transaction with appropriate isolation/locks:
A timeout requires status lookup, not automatic blind retry.
A database-level strategy must enforce or verify balance at commit, since application-only checks can be bypassed by direct writes.
| Source event | Provisional accounting shape | Must not occur until |
| Transfer between funds | Balanced, linked journal preserving both fund dimensions. | `D-02` allows transfer and required approval exists. |
A disputed transaction is explicitly flagged and held from public totals according to approved policy; its accounting treatment must be set with the accountant.
Phase 7 must not infer confirmed money from those pending rows.
A later approved migration must connect a separately verified source to an approved posting contract.
Money uses integer minor units or an approved exact decimal type; never binary floating point.
The database commit boundary must enforce or verify balance; the UI cannot be the only check.
A correction is a linked full/partial reversal plus a replacement where required; never edit or delete a posted journal.
Reopen/adjustment behavior requires explicit `D-01`/`D-03` policy.
Balances are derived from posted journal lines, never stored as editable authoritative totals.
These logical entities require review against the final accounting policy before a migration is written.

| `FiscalPeriod` | Fiscal-year/book/currency identifier, start/end, open/closed state, close actor/time/version. | Non-overlapping ranges per book/currency; journal date must belong to period; closed period blocks ordinary post. |

| `ExpensePayment` | Authorized payment source/reference, executor, date, amount, evidence and posting relation. | Unique execution reference; payment is distinct from approval and journal posting; no payment without required authorization. |

| `JournalEntry` | Source type/id, currency/book, fiscal period, effective date, state, idempotency key/payload fingerprint, maker/poster, approval reference, reversal link, private memo. | Unique source posting key and idempotency key; `POSTED` immutable; period/source/approval must be eligible. |
`reverseJournal(id, amountOrLines, reason, actor, approval)` creates an immutable linked reversal and never changes the original.
`reviseBudget(id, expectedVersion, lines, actor)` creates a new version with an approval requirement; it never overwrites an approved version.
Their exact order and authority must follow `D-02`/`D-03`.
All commands must use current identity from the database, server-side scope checks, Zod validation, optimistic versions and structured safe errors.

Provider/manual source verified → approved allocation policy → balanced journal draft → independent authorization if required → atomic post → receipt eligibility only under approved receipt policy → Phase 8 reconciliation.
